categoryName: Women wear — innerwear, ethnic, salwar-kameez, dupatta, leggings, nightwear, shawls

skuLines.line: Everyday cotton non-padded bra, core sizes
skuLines.examples: Groversons Paris Beauty, Lux Venus, Bodycare E-Series, Juliet
skuLines.seasonality: year-round; spike Jul-Sep monsoon (nothing dries, wardrobe needs spares)
skuLines.notes: Needs the FULL size ladder, not fast-movers only — a 38D who cannot buy here loses a whole trip to town. Snapdeal shows ₹88-915 but that is discounted marketplace floor; shelf price sits near MRP.

skuLines.examples: Jockey 1722, Enamor A042, Clovia, Amante
skuLines.notes: Branded innerwear is MRP-tight and distributor-controlled; thinner margin but it is the credibility SKU that stops the premium buyer leaving campus.

skuLines.examples: Jockey 1376, Enamor SB06, Clovia, Nykd
skuLines.seasonality: year-round; spike at sports meet / session start
skuLines.notes: Free-cup S-XXL sizing keeps inventory simple — 5 SKUs cover what 20 band-cup SKUs would.

skuLines.examples: Bodycare Teenz, Dollar Missy, Enamor Teenz, Lovable
skuLines.seasonality: year-round; hard spike at session start (Feb-Apr, Jul)
skuLines.notes: THE most-missed line in a general-store assortment. 1,500+ residential girls aged 5-18 with no parent nearby and no market within 30-50 km. Sell via the matron/warden, not open shelf.

skuLines.examples: Inner Sense, Morph Maternity, Clovia Maternity, Bodycare
skuLines.notes: Zero substitute within 30-50 km of hill road, and a new mother cannot make that trip. Low velocity, non-negotiable stocking.

skuLines.examples: Bodycare, Lux Venus, Groversons, Shyaway
skuLines.notes: Plus-size at the value end is now a core line, not a niche. Skipping it silently pushes older non-teaching staff off campus.

skuLines.examples: Bodycare pack of 3, Lux Venus 3-pack, Dollar Missy
skuLines.seasonality: spike Jul-Sep monsoon and at session start
skuLines.notes: Multipacks are the right format for a closed campus: one purchase covers the drying gap in monsoon.

skuLines.examples: Clovia, Zivame, Amante, Nykd
skuLines.notes: Fastest-growing bra format among 18-25s; reads modest and is comfort-first, which fits the institution.

skuLines.examples: Jockey 1406 3-pack, Bodycare, Lux Venus, Dollar Missy
skuLines.notes: Highest-unit-volume innerwear line. Pack-of-5/6 is the single best monsoon SKU on this whole list — heavy rain means garments do not dry and residents buy depth, not variety.

skuLines.examples: Bodycare, Lux Venus, Rupa Softline, Dollar Missy
skuLines.notes: The traditional/older cohort will not buy hipsters. Two different products, not one with size variants.

skuLines.examples: Adira, Nua, Sirona, Bella
skuLines.notes: Newly mainstream. Very high fit for a girls' hostel with limited laundry and no midnight shop; discreet sale through the matron works better than shelf.

skuLines.examples: Dixcy Slimz Kids, Bodycare Kids, Rupa Frontline, KIDBIRD
skuLines.notes: Snapdeal girls' innerwear runs ₹113-982 with packs to 12. Buy by age-band, not fashion.

skuLines.line: Women's cotton kachhera (Sikh article of faith)
skuLines.examples: Amritsar/Ludhiana gurdwara-supply makers, Khalsa Store grade white cotton, drawstring 'nara'
skuLines.seasonality: year-round; spike at Amrit Sanchar ceremonies and Baisakhi (Apr)
skuLines.notes: The single most institution-specific line on this list. Wikipedia's Five Ks entry is explicit that women are equally expected to wear the kachhera, as an undergarment. At a Kalgidhar Trust campus this is a religious obligation, not apparel — running out of stock is a different class of failure from running out of kurtis. Source it locally from Punjab, hold deep stock in every waist size.

skuLines.examples: Dollar Missy, Lux Venus, Bodycare, Rupa Softline, AIMLY
skuLines.packSizes: pack of 1, 2, 3; XS-3XL and free size
skuLines.notes: Worn under every kurti, so it is the highest-frequency garment a woman here owns. Snapdeal shows 814 camisole SKUs at ₹121-510. Stock white/skin/black deep and let colours be shallow.

skuLines.examples: Bodycare, Lux Venus, local Ludhiana
skuLines.notes: Needed under thin cotton kurtas and sarees. Ankle-length only — Indian slips are 'rarely shorter than ankle length'.

skuLines.examples: Bodycare, Vami, local Ludhiana mill goods
skuLines.notes: Only matters in proportion to how many non-teaching staff and elderly wear sarees daily — keep it shallow but present, in white/black/matching basics.

skuLines.examples: Dermawear, Swee Shapers, Zivame, Clovia
skuLines.notes: Bought before an event, never routinely. Snapdeal band ₹104-777. Two sizes deep, four styles wide at most.

skuLines.examples: Sirona, Dermawear, Tynor, Mylo
skuLines.notes: Borderline medical-adjacent; the campus hospital may be the better channel. Stock 2-3 sizes as a service item.

skuLines.examples: Lux Inferno, Rupa Thermocot, Dollar Ultra, Neva, Kanvin
skuLines.notes: The single biggest seasonal bet in this category for a cold hill township. Branded thermals are MRP-tight so margin is thin, but a stock-out in December is unforgivable and un-substitutable. Commit the buy in Aug-Sep — hill road freight in Dec-Jan is slow and snow-risked.

skuLines.line: Thermal top only, long sleeve high-neck
skuLines.examples: Lux Inferno, Rupa Thermocot, Dollar, C9 Airwear
skuLines.notes: Sells 2-3x the bottoms — women replace the top more often. Do not buy sets 1:1.

skuLines.examples: Lux Inferno, Rupa Thermocot, Dollar, Paryag
skuLines.notes: Worn under salwar/legging. Buy shallower than tops.

skuLines.examples: Bodycare Kids, Dixcy Slimz, Neva, Lux Inferno Kids
skuLines.notes: Hostel children cannot go shopping when the cold arrives. Pre-book size-wise with hostel matrons in Sep — this is an indent item, not a shelf item.

skuLines.examples: Lyra Winter, De Moza, Twin Birds thermal legging
skuLines.notes: The hill-specific twist on the highest-volume line. Black does 60%+ of the volume.

skuLines.examples: Neva, Bonjour, Balenzia, Marc
skuLines.notes: Cheap, tiny, freight-efficient, and the classic hill stock-out. Buy in depth — it is the highest ratio of comfort-per-rupee-of-shelf-space here.

skuLines.line: Cotton ankle / crew socks multipack, incl. white school socks
skuLines.examples: Bonjour, Neska Moda, Balenzia, Dollar, HF Lumen
skuLines.seasonality: year-round; hard spike at session start
skuLines.notes: White uniform socks are a uniform-compliance item, not apparel — hold them in the school's exact colour and length or the demand leaks to town. Snapdeal shows packs to 10 at ₹99-764.

skuLines.examples: Lyra, Dollar Missy, Twin Birds, Go Colors
skuLines.packSizes: single, sometimes pack of 2; free size + S-3XL; black/navy/white/skin
skuLines.notes: The highest-velocity apparel SKU in the whole women's assortment — worn daily under every kurti by students, university girls and staff alike. Black and skin are half the volume. Never out of stock, in any size.

skuLines.examples: Lyra Churidar, Twin Birds, local Ludhiana
skuLines.notes: Distinct from ankle-length legging — traditional cohort asks for it by name. Cheap to carry alongside.

skuLines.line: Printed / coloured legging and ankle jeggings
skuLines.examples: Go Colors, Dollar Missy, Robin Romeo, PREEGO
skuLines.notes: Fashion tail. Keep narrow — colour legging is where small stores bury cash in dead sizes.

skuLines.examples: Go Colors, W, Aurelia, local Ludhiana
skuLines.notes: Modest, forgiving on size (free size covers a wide range) — low inventory risk for the fashion it buys.

skuLines.line: Patiala salwar / plain ready-made cotton salwar
skuLines.examples: Local Patiala & Ludhiana makers, ALTECIA, Shree Radhe
skuLines.notes: Strongly Punjabi and still school-standard in much of north India. Local sourcing gives the best margin on this list.

skuLines.examples: Go Colors, Aurelia, Biba, W
skuLines.notes: The teaching-staff workwear bottom. Navy/black/beige only.

skuLines.examples: Sirgo, Off Limits, Dollar Missy, Ap'pulse
skuLines.seasonality: year-round; spike Oct-Mar (warmth) and at session start
skuLines.notes: Hostel-room and PT wear. Modest full-length only — shorts are not the product here.

skuLines.examples: Aurelia, Rangmanch by Pantaloons, Anouk, local Jaipur prints
skuLines.notes: Modest cuts only — full/three-quarter sleeve, high neck, knee-length or below. Stock the size ladder to 3XL; a closed campus has no second shop for an XXL.

skuLines.line: Printed rayon / viscose kurti, value tier
skuLines.examples: PRISTINO, Ras Rani, sajrika, Meesho-tier local
skuLines.notes: Rayon has quietly replaced pure cotton at the value end because it drapes better AND dries faster — a real advantage in a heavy-monsoon location. Best margin in ethnic; highest style-obsolescence risk, so buy shallow and rotate.

skuLines.examples: Janasya, Anubhutee, Vishudh, Libas
skuLines.notes: The co-ord set is now the default new ethnic purchase, replacing single-kurti buying. Higher ticket lifts the ₹208 average bill materially.

skuLines.examples: Biba, Aurelia, W, local Ludhiana
skuLines.seasonality: Gurpurab (Nov, Dec/Jan), Baisakhi (Apr), Hola Mohalla (Mar), wedding season Nov-Feb & Apr-May
skuLines.notes: The premium end of this whole category and the biggest single leak to town. If ARY carries no festive suit, an entire family's festival budget leaves the campus in one trip.

skuLines.line: Unstitched dress material / suit length (3 pc)
skuLines.examples: PANZORA, Kashvi, MAHISA, local Ludhiana mill goods
skuLines.notes: CONDITIONAL: unstitched material without a tailor is dead stock. Only carry this if an on-campus stitching tie-up exists — with one, it becomes the cheapest way to offer 'custom fit' to every size on campus and needs no size inventory at all. That makes it the highest-leverage line here.

skuLines.examples: Libas, Janasya, Biba, Aurelia
skuLines.notes: Occasion-only. Buy against the festival calendar and clear it — do not carry into summer break when the campus empties.

skuLines.line: Winter woollen / wool-blend kurti and long kurta
skuLines.examples: Aarika, local Ludhiana knitwear, Fabindia-tier khadi wool
skuLines.notes: Thick-fabric full-sleeve kurta is what actually gets worn Nov-Feb here. Wikipedia's kurta entry confirms wool/khadi-silk winter kurtas are the traditional cold-weather form — this is not a fashion invention.

skuLines.line: Quilted / Nehru ethnic jacket over kurta
skuLines.examples: Local Amritsar & Ludhiana, Aarika
skuLines.notes: Layering piece that reads modest and formal for teaching staff. Shallow buy.

skuLines.line: Plain cotton / malmal chunni — white, cream, dark
skuLines.examples: Local Amritsar & Ludhiana chunni makers, gurdwara-supply grade
skuLines.packSizes: single, sometimes pack of 2; standard 2.25-2.5 m
skuLines.seasonality: year-round; spike at session start and every Gurpurab
skuLines.notes: The highest-frequency religious/uniform item for women here. Wikipedia's dupatta entry: women cover their heads with a dupatta to enter a gurdwara, and 'Sikh women traditionally wore the dupatta/chunni'. On a Khalsa campus with daily diwan attendance, chunnis are washed, lost and replaced constantly. Deep stock in white and the uniform colour; excellent margin; almost no fashion risk.

skuLines.examples: RAS RANI, kedar fab, om vastra, local Surat prints
skuLines.notes: Bought to match an existing suit, so breadth of colour beats depth. Snapdeal dupatta band ₹122-2,499.

skuLines.examples: Amritsar phulkari artisans, Punjabi Virsa, Kashvi
skuLines.seasonality: Baisakhi, Gurpurab, weddings; gifting to visiting parents and overseas students
skuLines.notes: Culturally central, not decorative: phulkari ('art of flowers') is Punjab's own embroidery and was traditionally part of a girl's trousseau. At a Sikh institution with 200 overseas students it doubles as the take-home gift item.

skuLines.examples: Local Ludhiana acrylic, Kullu-border stoles, Sprha
skuLines.notes: Does double duty — head covering for diwan AND warmth. That dual function makes it a better winter buy than a plain shawl for the student cohort.

skuLines.line: Ramaal / small cotton head scarf for girls
skuLines.examples: Local Amritsar makers, gurdwara-supply
skuLines.notes: For younger hostel girls covering kesh. Tiny ticket, near-zero freight cost, genuine daily need — classic 'do without' item if absent.

skuLines.line: Woollen shawl, plain and check, full size
skuLines.examples: Local Amritsar & Panipat, Goodluck, Kashmiri, Vrinde
skuLines.notes: The default hill winter garment for older women — worn indoors as much as out. Snapdeal band ₹241-1,320. Bulky: commit freight in Sep-Oct before hill-road winter.

skuLines.examples: Bhuttico (Kullu weavers' co-op), Kullu Shawl GI weavers
skuLines.seasonality: Oct-Mar; heavy gifting season and parents' visiting days
skuLines.notes: Local sourcing advantage — ARY is IN Himachal, so this is shorter-freight and higher-trust than anything imported. It is also the natural gift a parent or an overseas student buys on the way out. Strategic line, not a filler.

skuLines.examples: Kashmiri pashmina, Bhuttico fine wool
skuLines.notes: Pashmina is the fine under-fleece of Himalayan goats — genuinely warm and light, and genuinely counterfeited. Carry 3-6 pieces max as the premium anchor; authenticity risk is the reason to keep it shallow.

skuLines.examples: Monte Carlo, Aarika, Khalsa Knitwear, Ogarti, Zigo
skuLines.notes: Snapdeal band ₹175-1,328 with sizes to 7XL. Cardigan outsells pullover for women who wear kurtas — it goes on and off over a dupatta.

skuLines.line: Girls' school cardigan / sweater in uniform colours
skuLines.examples: Neva, local uniform knitwear (Ludhiana), Khalsa Knitwear
skuLines.notes: Only works in the school's EXACT uniform colour — a near-miss navy is unsaleable. Confirm the shade with Akal Academy before buying, and indent size-wise through hostel wardens.

skuLines.examples: Vami, Sleepify, Bodycare, Neha Fashion, local Ludhiana
skuLines.notes: Top-volume nightwear for married staff and elderly. Snapdeal lists nighty, kaftan nighty, t-shirt nighty at ₹123-1,195 — free size covers most of the ladder, so inventory risk is low and margin is among the best in the category.

skuLines.examples: Clovia, Sleepify, Dollar Missy, Innerlaze
skuLines.notes: Hostel-appropriate where a nighty is not — shared rooms and corridors mean girls want a top-and-pyjama, full-length. Do not substitute one for the other.

skuLines.line: Woollen / fleece nighty and winter night suit
skuLines.examples: Local Ludhiana fleece, Neva, Zeffit, CTMTEX
skuLines.packSizes: single or 2-pc set; free size + S-3XL
skuLines.notes: Hill-specific and routinely under-bought. Unheated rooms at ~1,700 m mean sleepwear IS winterwear here; Snapdeal confirms fleece and woollen as standard nightwear fabrics.

skuLines.examples: Morph Maternity, Inner Sense, Mylo, local
skuLines.notes: Snapdeal lists nursing nighty and maternity nighty as distinct types. Low velocity, no local substitute, and the buyer is housebound — a service line.

skuLines.line: Maternity kurta / maternity legging / maternity dress
skuLines.examples: Janasya, Morph, Mylo, Raagvisha
skuLines.notes: Snapdeal band ₹159-2,998. Married staff quarters with small children and babies means a steady trickle of pregnancies — carry a small permanent block rather than reacting each time.

skuLines.line: Cotton / synthetic daily saree with blouse piece
skuLines.examples: ANAND SAREES, local Surat synthetics, Mysore silk-blend
skuLines.notes: Most sarees ship 'with unstitched blouse piece' — which again only converts if a tailor is available on campus. Size the buy to the actual saree-wearing headcount among non-teaching staff, not to general Indian averages.

skuLines.examples: Vami, local Ludhiana, Bodycare
skuLines.notes: The ready-made blouse is what makes a saree wearable without a tailor. If you stock sarees, stock these in matching basics (black, white, maroon, navy) or the saree does not sell.

skuLines.line: Innerwear accessories — bra extenders, straps, cup pads, dupatta pins
skuLines.examples: Local, Clovia accessories, Snapdeal-tier bra clips and nipple covers
skuLines.notes: Trivial value, disproportionate goodwill — a dupatta pin is a daily need on a campus where every woman wears one. Best margin per rupee of shelf space in the whole category, near-zero freight, no obsolescence.

trends2026: Basics-apparel has migrated into replenishment retail: BigBasket, Blinkit, Zepto, JioMart and DMart now run innerwear, leggings, socks and thermals as grocery-cadence SKUs rather than shopping-trip purchases. ARY is structurally the same kind of store — this validates treating multipack innerwear, camisoles, leggings and socks as never-out-of-stock staples, not as an apparel department.

Size inclusivity has moved to the value end. Marketplace filters now routinely run XS-7XL on kurtis, sweaters and camisoles, and 30-44 band with plus cups on bras, from budget brands (Bodycare, Lux Venus, Shyaway) rather than only premium ones. A store serving a fixed, known population can now actually cover its whole size ladder cheaply.
Period / leak-proof underwear has gone mainstream at ₹300-800 (Adira, Nua, Sirona, Bella) and is a strong fit for a girls' residential hostel with limited laundry access.
Wire-free, seamless and bralette formats are displacing wired padded bras for the 18-25 cohort — comfort-first, and incidentally the most modest-reading silhouette, which suits this institution.
Co-ord sets (kurta+pant, tunic+palazzo) have become the default new ethnic purchase, replacing single-kurti buying — a higher-ticket format that lifts average bill.

Rayon and viscose have displaced pure cotton at the value end of kurtis and nightwear. Beyond price, they dry markedly faster — a real, under-appreciated advantage in a location with heavy monsoon and no dryers.

Thermal innerwear is premiumising: modal/merino blends and 'warm-tech' branding (Lux Inferno, Kanvin, Dollar Ultra) at ₹700-1,500 now sit above the ₹350-500 cotton-blend basics, creating a two-tier winter buy where there used to be one.

Regional handloom identity is being worn daily rather than only at weddings — phulkari dupattas and Himachali/Kullu shawl motifs as everyday pieces. For a Himachal-based Sikh institution this is both a local-sourcing cost advantage (Bhuttico/Kullu co-ops, Amritsar phulkari) and a gifting line for visiting parents and overseas students.
adjacentServices: On-campus stitching / tailoring counter — converts unstitched suit lengths and saree blouse pieces into sales, and offers custom fit to every size on campus with ZERO size inventory. This is the highest-leverage service attached to this category; without it, dress material and blouse pieces are dead stock.

Alteration and repair — hemming leggings and salwars, taking in kurtas, replacing hooks, zips and elastic. Worth far more here than in a town because the alternative is a 30-50 km hill trip for a ₹30 job.

Private bra-fitting / size measurement by a woman staff member, in a curtained corner — the single biggest unlock for innerwear sell-through in a conservative institution, where the real barrier is not price but not knowing your size and not wanting to ask.

Pre-packed new-admission kits by size (innerwear set + socks + chunni + nightwear + thermal), sold at admission to arriving students and parents — one order per arrival instead of twenty small transactions, and it captures spend at the exact moment parents are on campus with a wallet open.
Hostel-wise size-wise indent for wardens and matrons — bulk innerwear, socks, thermals and girls' cardigans ordered on the hostel's behalf, so a 12-year-old never has to solve her own supply problem.
Winter kit pre-book, taken Aug-Sep and delivered Oct — locks demand before the cold, lets ARY commit hill-road freight early and cheaply, and lets parents pay ahead of the child needing it.

Special-order / weekly indent for sizes, colours and styles not held, filled on the store's own run to Solan / Nahan / Chandigarh — turns every stock-out from a lost sale and a lost trip into a 7-day promise.
Gifting counter for phulkari dupattas and Kullu shawls, with wrapping — aimed at visiting parents and the ~200 overseas students who leave with gifts.
No-questions size exchange window — essential where trying-on is limited and a wrong size otherwise means a wasted trip to town.
Woollen wash / dry-clean drop-off and collection point for shawls, sweaters and suits — the nearest facility is off-campus, and it pulls the customer back into the store twice per garment.
sourcesConsulted: METHOD CAVEAT — read this first: this session's WebSearch budget was already fully consumed (200/200 calls) before my first query, so this list is built from ~40 direct WebFetch attempts, not from search. BigBasket, JioMart, Zepto, Blinkit, Ajio, DMart Ready, Vogue India, Economic Times Retail, indiaretailing and Fibre2Fashion all returned 403 / 404 / 405 / empty JS shells. Snapdeal was the one Indian marketplace that rendered, so it carries most of the pricing and taxonomy weight below.

PRICE CAVEAT: Snapdeal figures are heavily discounted marketplace prices (typically 50-85% off MRP) and are a FLOOR, not a shelf price. The priceBand values above are my adjustment of those toward physical-retail, near-MRP selling — that adjustment is my inference, not observed ARY or competitor shelf data.

MARGIN CAVEAT: every marginBand is Indian apparel-trade convention (branded innerwear/thermals thin and MRP-controlled; local/unbranded ethnic, nightwear, chunnis and accessories fat). I could not load a single verified margin source — Screener's Page Industries figures were behind login and IBEF gave no segment margins. Treat all margin numbers as indicative, not sourced.
